description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling PolicyEntriesModified events within the policies persistence component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract class to implement specific logic for updating policy entries based on the event data.

classes.name: PolicyEntriesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles PolicyEntriesModified events by updating a given policy with new policy entries.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Handles the PolicyEntriesModified event by removing existing entries and setting new entries in the policy builder.
